audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer read "Skill" on all seven rows while the content layer and packet levelChart read Orianna, Orianna, Skill, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Orianna.
audit.why: Cassiopeia is mana-starved and short-ranged at 1-2 against an 815 Q; from level 4 Miasma plus 0.75s Twin Fang out-trades anything in her puddle and Petrifying Gaze answers the Shockwave setup; by two items Orianna's engage lands before the DoT ramps.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved onto the content values, with phases[3..5].why rewritten to describe Cassiopeia winning those stages and their ratings dropped to 4/10.

audit.why: Spike order is right: her 3-5 Twin Fang window, Petrifying Gaze at 6, first-item kiting sustain, then Orianna's two-item teamfight flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no number and the decisive interaction was stated as a generic grounding note.
audit.why: Miasma (W) is 24/22/20/18/16 and both grounds and slows; Twin Fang (E) is a 0.75s cooldown that heals her off poisoned targets; Petrifying Gaze (R) is 120/100/80 and only stuns enemies facing her. Orianna has no dash, so the grounding matters far less than the fact that her whole damage pattern needs you standing in the puddle.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field, dos/donts bodies and phases whys rebuilt on those timers; the engage-angle answer to Petrifying Gaze kept.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was mentioned only in a misgendered clause.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of damage dealt, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: report[8].t corrected to 'her sustain'; the Twin Fang heal is now stated in breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nineteen misgendering defects (Cassiopeia called he/his/him), two copy-paste bleeds, one unsupported magnitude, and 'Command Attack' for Command: Attack.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists cassiopeia as female; lint findings are deterministic.
audit.corrected: Every flagged field rewritten or pronoun-corrected.
